visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with long blonde hair, dressed in a brown and beige plaid mini dress paired with a white ruffled skirt underneath and tall brown leather boots. She is standing on a sidewalk in front of a modern storefront with a black facade and a large white sign that reads 'ATiiSSU'. The lighting is bright natural daylight, and she strikes a dynamic pose with one leg kicked up, holding a small pink handbag. (2) Inside the store, the environment is minimalist and avant-garde, featuring raw concrete walls, metallic sculptures that look like crumpled foil, and large white sculptural display units. The woman is seen walking through the space and crouching down near a silver sculpture, while wearing a blue patterned scarf-style hat. The lighting inside is bright and even studio-style illumination. (3) The camera focuses on various headwear items displayed on white mannequin heads along a shelf. These include a light blue fabric wrap, a grey visor with a black ribbon, and several knit beanies in colors like burgundy and charcoal with long, thin braided cords hanging from the sides. The woman is later seen in a mirror selfie wearing one of these brown knit beanies, holding a pink smartphone with a decorative case. (4) The woman tries on a series of baseball caps, starting with a black one that has a thick band of sequined or beaded floral-like texture on the brim. She poses in front of a mirror, adjusting the cap and showing it from different angles. Another shot shows a grey denim-like cap with a black ribbon tie at the back. The background features more hats on shelves and clean, industrial-style retail interior. (5) In a different section of the store, which has a wall of small illuminated square cubbies, the woman tries on a light blue knit cowboy hat with tassels. She poses playfully, holding the tassels and looking into the camera. She then switches to a reddish-brown patterned beanie and another black cap. (6) The woman is seen in a large floor-length mirror, modeling a black patterned bucket hat. She strikes several poses, including a 'crying' gesture with her hands to her face, corresponding to the 'sold out' text. The final shots show close-ups of basic caps in navy and cream with the 'ATiiSSU' brand name embroidered on the front, placed on a marble-patterned surface.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天來到聖鷗亭. [Logo]: ATiiSSU. (2) [Subtitle]: Gentle Monster旗下新的帽子品牌. (3) [Subtitle]: 店風格很有Gentle monster的感覺. (4) [Subtitle]: 很前衛的設計感. (5) [Subtitle]: 像這個針織毛帽我覺得還蠻好看的. (6) [Subtitle]: 戴起來就是有那種潮潮的感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 棒球帽的設計也有小巧思. (8) [Subtitle]: 戴起來不無聊. (9) [Subtitle]: 我發現他們家棒球帽的帽簷都偏長. (10) [Subtitle]: 不過版型還蠻好看. (11) [Subtitle]: 店內二樓的款式更多. (12) [Subtitle]: 我還看到了一見鍾情的帽子. (13) [Subtitle]: 就是這一頂. (14) [Subtitle]: 有點像牛仔帽. (15) [Subtitle]: 穿白T配牛仔褲. (16) [Subtitle]: 搭這頂帽子為穿搭加超多分. (17) [Subtitle]: 結果啊 因為它5月份就開幕到現在. (18) [Subtitle]: 因為太熱門. [Variety]: 很多款式都已經 sold out. (19) [Subtitle]: 我直接原地哭出來. (20) [Subtitle]: 但是在店裡試戴了很多款. (21) [Subtitle]: 拍拍照啊 拍影片. (22) [Subtitle]: 還是很滿足. (23) [Subtitle]: 只能說帽子從設計到材質都很時髦. (24) [Subtitle]: 而且也不容易撞款. (25) [Subtitle]: 當然基本款的帽子也是有的. (26) [Subtitle]: 價格大概落在2000臺幣左右. (27) [Subtitle]: 也可以去官網瀏覽更多款式跟價格. (28) [Subtitle]: 但我問了店員. (29) [Subtitle]: 他說目前還沒有寄送的服務. (30) [Subtitle]: 只能希望下次來貨量更齊全啦. [Variety]: 哭哭.
